newsitem.title: CHINA: Up to 80 pct of China's mobile phones smuggled.
newsitem.headline: Up to 80 pct of China's mobile phones smuggled.

text.p: Up to 80 percent of mobile phones on sale in China are smuggled, the Economic Information Daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper gave no reason for the high proportion of smuggled mobile phones, which cost less.
China's State Information Centre said many mobile phones on the market were of low quality or fake, it said, adding that the market share of Chinese-made mobile phones was small.
The authorities should promulgate rules to regulate the fast-growing market and step up customs inspections to curb smuggling, the newspaper said.

The number of mobile phone subscribers in China surged to 5.36 million by the end of July from 3.62 million at the end of last year, showing a 48 percent growth in just seven months, according to state media.
